title: Algerian Jewish Sign Language
displaytitle: Algerian Jewish Sign Language

titles.display: Algerian Jewish Sign Language

extract: Algerian Jewish Sign Language (AJSL), also known as Ghardaia Sign Language, is a moribund village sign language originally of Ghardaïa, Algeria that is now used in Israel and possibly also in France.
